svg.title: Logistic regression vs SVM-RBF metrics, and range RMSE
svg.desc: Horizontal bar charts on a 0 to 1 score axis. Logistic regression (white bars) vs SVM-RBF (blue bars): accuracy 0.8575 vs 0.8961, precision 0.8967 vs 0.9297, recall 0.8081 vs 0.8569, F1 0.8501 vs 0.8918. Range RMSE (black bars, 0 to 2 metre axis): 1.7566 m for path 1 and path 2.
